answer_1.quote: The general Retrieval-augmented Generation (RAG) framework has recently become the cornerstone of many search-based conversational agents, such as Copilot and Doubao. In this setting, LMs frequently need to synthesise information from multiple retrieved search results to provide coherent answers.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are answers to multi-hop questions, often in the format \boxed{\langle answer \rangle}, based on reasoning over multiple retrieved documents.

answer_2.quote: We use the accuracy metric (Acc) to measure MHQA performance.
